ios.desc: Test your knowledge in this addictive trivia game! Guess movies, celebrities, books, and more using progressive hints. Choose from 6 categories, tackle the daily challenge, and climb global leaderboards. Use power-ups like reveal letter and skip to your advantage. Build winning streaks and earn coins for premium features. Perfect for quick brain-teasing fun anytime!

quotes.text:
Competitive trivia game where every hint you reveal reduces your score. The challenge: guess the answer using as few clues as possible.

Features real-time 1v1 duels, daily challenges, and multiple categories. The core mechanic rewards deduction over encyclopedic knowledge.

Try it: hintop.io
iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hintop/id6757975518

Hi HN,

I’ve built Hintop, a trivia game where instead of multiple-choice answers you get progressive hints.
The goal is to guess as early as possible, fewer hints = more points.

I’m especially interested in feedback on:
• whether the core mechanic feels engaging long-term
• onboarding / first-time experience
• ideas to improve retention without adding complexity

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hintop/id6757975518
Web version: http://hintop.io

Happy to answer any questions.
